name: How do rideshare insurance policies work in San Diego?

mainEntity.name: How do rideshare insurance policies work in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: In San Diego, as elsewhere, rideshare companies like Uber and Lyft maintain significant insurance policies that apply depending on the driver's status at the time of the accident. During Period 0 (app off), the driver's personal insurance applies. During Period 1 (app on, waiting for a request), a limited liability policy may activate. During Periods 2 and 3 (en route to pickup or with passenger), the rideshare company's full liability coverage, often $1 million or more, becomes active. Navigating these layers requires an attorney experienced with local and state regulations and rideshare specific policies.
acceptedAnswer.description: Rideshare insurance in San Diego depends on the driver's status: personal insurance for off-app, limited coverage for waiting, and full company coverage ($1M+) when en route or with a passenger.
